user.title: Connect your SmartKnob
user.description: Experimental local firmware required. Copy the device key from the Knob's setup Wi-Fi page, or request it over USB with lowercase l. This is not a Home Assistant token. HTTP is unencrypted: use a trusted local network.

lights.title: Choose devices and scenes
lights.description: Choose one to ten lights, scenes, or media players. Turn for media volume and press briefly for play/pause.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect, wrong device, or incompatible firmware. Check the address and local firmware.
error.invalid_auth: The device key was rejected. Copy all 64 characters.
error.invalid_selection: Select one to ten existing lights, scenes, or media players with entity IDs shorter than 64 characters.

abort.already_configured: This SmartKnob is already configured or ignored.
abort.unsupported_device: This device does not support the local protocol.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered device could not be verified.

init.title: Choose devices and scenes
init.description: After changing this selection, restart the Knob. Media players use rotation for volume and a short press for play/pause.
